description: No practice site has an export button, so the recipe adds one to the page (a link to a CSV of the quotes shown), then clicks it and reads the file it downloads.

steps.script: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll(".quote")].map(quote => [quote.querySelector(".text").textContent, quote.querySelector(".author").textContent]); const csv = ["text,author", ...rows.map(row => row.map(cell => `"${cell.replaceAll("\"", "\"\"")}"`).join(","))].join("\n"); const link = document.createElement("a"); link.id = "export"; link.download = "quotes.csv"; link.textContent = "Export CSV"; link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" })); document.querySelector(".header-box p").append(" ", link); return rows.length })()
